subject: Speeding up multistate models for joint live recapture and dead recovery data

messages.author: 39971e2c19b8ec70
messages.subject: Speeding up multistate models for joint live recapture and dead recovery data
parts:
Hello!

I am currently reviewing a paper where they use IPM containing a multistate model for joint live recapture and dead recovery data, which calculates also permanent emigration. It is similar to models in Kery & Schaub 2012 (BPA), chapter 9.5., but there are more states (juv alive in, juv alive outside, ad alive in, ad alive outside, dead, not seen). This part of the model is very slow since it loops over individuals, making the models run ~ 2 weeks without convergence.

I had some ideas how to speed up the models using generalized m-arrays (would be 3-dimensional m-arrays). I am trying to figure out if this was already used/published somewhere? Do you know of anyone who successfuly transformed their multistate models into m-array formulation?

I've seen older messages in this group on the solution with Nimble (https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10651-016-0353-z), but I am now interested in whether someone already implemented the m-array solution.

Thank you very much!

Tomas
